profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | iOS Engineer | Cloud Engineer | CSD®
profile.summary:
Passionate about creating innovative products centered around finance, health, music, basketball and much more!

Currently a Full Stack Software Engineer at Embarque Tenares Corp. building end to end solutions for our teams and clients

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Client-Facing Web App (https://www.embarquetenares.com)
- Transformed a static HTML & CSS site into a dynamic, multilingual platform using TypeScript, Vue.js, and Quasar, boosting user engagement by 45% and enhancing brand perception.
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, reducing deployment times and increasing productivity by 40%. 
- Migrated from on-prem Go backend servers to a serverless architecture with Firebase Authentication and Firestore, improving scalability, reducing maintenance, and enhancing system performance.

Client-Facing Mobile App (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/embarque-tenares-corp/id1617138118):
- Created and designed native a mobile application using Swift, enhancing performance, user experience, and maintainability while future-proofing the application. 
- Developed a Go-based backend server with a PostgreSQL database, containerized and deployed on CentOS Linux, ensuring robust security for global access.

Internal Mobile App
- Spearheading the iOS version of the company’s software using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and MVVM, while implementing unit testing for maintainability and reliability. 
- Collaborating with the original creators to integrate complex features such as client/employee management, invoicing, inventory, and appointments into a seamless, scalable application. 
- Applying Agile methodologies to enhance communication, resolve impediments, and adjust the development roadmap.

Internal Python and Web Apps
- Developed a Python and MongoDB application for transaction and route management, later transitioning it to a cloud-hosted React platform using Cloud Run and Firestore.
- Built a Flask app to extract and geocode addresses, integrating OpenAI's GPT model and Google Maps API for intelligent processing and interactive map visualization. 
- Deployed using Docker and Google Cloud Run, ensuring scalability and security, while setting up CI/CD pipelines with GitHub and Google Cloud for rapid, reliable updates.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Directed the development of a modern Next.js application with TypeScript for a luxury beachfront property rental business, implementing responsive design and internationalization (i18n) support for multiple languages.

- Integrated Google Maps Platform using the Maps Embed API to showcase property locations and nearby attractions, while optimizing performance through static page generation and lazy loading.

- Engineered a mobile-first UI using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion animations, achieving optimal Core Web Vitals scores through efficient asset loading and component optimization.

- Achieved a 50% increase in customer acquisition and user engagement by enhancing the website's accessibility and user experience.
positions.insights: JavaScript, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and +4 skills

positions.title: The Lawrentian (Web Development Manager)
positions.description:
- Ensured timely publication of each issue of The Lawrentian by uploading content to Lawrentian.com every Friday before 5 p.m.

- Leveraged WordPress platform and evaluated WP plugins to optimize website functionality and user experience.

- Customized code including stylesheets and plugins to align with specific project requirements and organizational branding.

- Proactively supported and initiated various web-related projects and programs as per organizational needs.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Certified Associate Cloud Engineer
certifications.title: Google Cloud Certified Associate Cloud Engineer

courses.name: Advanced Data Structures and Algorithm Analysis

projects.title: Real Time Stock Streamer and Analysis
projects.description:
Developed a real-time financial data streaming system using Python and WebSockets that processes and analyzes live market data from Schwab's API, implementing technical indicators and multi-timeframe aggregation for automated trading signal generation

Engineered an automated email notification system with SMTP integration that provides real-time alerts for trading signals and position changes, while ensuring secure credential management through environment variables and robust error handling

projects.title: Twitter Bots (@InfiniteAffirm and @Hourly_Bible_)
projects.description:
Developed automated Twitter bots aimed at promoting positivity on the X platform using Python and the Tweepy library for streamlined API integration.

Designed and implemented time-based automation workflows using Google Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and Topics to ensure consistent and reliable content delivery.

Integrated secure Identity and Access Management (IAM) by utilizing environment variables and granular service account permissions across the entire system.

Programmatically generated dynamic images with text overlays using Python’s Pillow library, demonstrating advanced skills in automated UI and content generation.

Utilized Google Cloud Storage for efficient management of media assets, optimizing the storage and retrieval of images, affirmations, and custom fonts.

Built a robust Python pipeline to ingest and transform large volumes of Bible data into Google Cloud Firestore, enabling fast and cost-effective retrieval of random verses tailored to application needs.
